description: This file defines the SeatChangeTrackingService class, which manages seat change logs, updates high water marks, and provides methods for retrieving and processing seat change data within a billing system.

classes.name: SeatChangeTrackingService
classes.description: A service class for tracking seat changes, updating high water marks, and retrieving seat change data within a billing context.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SeatChangeTrackingService with dependencies, supporting both legacy and new dependency injection patterns.

methods.name: logSeatAddition
methods.description: Logs a seat addition event and updates high water mark if applicable.

methods.name: updateHighWaterMarkIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks feature flags and updates the high water mark for a team if conditions are met.

methods.name: getMonthlyChanges
methods.description: Retrieves the total additions, removals, and net change for a team in a specific month.

methods.name: getUnprocessedChanges
methods.description: Fetches unprocessed seat change logs for a team and month.

methods.name: markAsProcessed
methods.description: Marks seat change logs as processed for a given proration ID.
